issues.where: the keyboard, red error badges across rows 2-4 (and continuing in set-B-02 and set-B-04)
issues.what: several 'Invalid email' badges are clipped mid-word by the keyboard edge or by other badges ('...d email', 'Invalid em...', 'Invalid er...'), reading as broken garbled text at normal viewing size and speed
issues.fix: never let badge text clip against a key edge or another badge; keep each badge fully inside clear space with its full label readable for its whole life on screen

issues.where: the claimed 'hit' across the whole sheet
issues.what: the hit is not legible: a tiny orange element hops between distant keys (Tab to Q to 4 to 3) between frames with no visible press, no key depression, and nothing on the page reacting; without the caption I could not tell what happened or that anything was hit
issues.fix: slow the presser into each key with a short wind-up, visibly depress the key on the contact frame, spring it back, and hold a beat so the field above ('Perpl' typing) reads as the consequence

issues.where: the red 'Invalid email' badges as they appear, all four sheets
issues.what: badges pop in fully formed with no anticipation, squash or settle, then sit rigid; motion is even and weightless throughout, and the multiplying duplicates look hand-placed rather than mechanical
issues.fix: give each badge a 2-3 frame entrance with a slight overshoot and settle, remove the arbitrary duplication, and let only one clear badge answer each error moment

issues.where: keyboard keys under every badge and key press, all sheets
issues.what: no contact response anywhere: keys never go down or spring back, and the form fields above never answer the event below; the page is frozen apart from the badges
issues.fix: on each contact frame, dip the struck key 1-2 px with a tightened shadow, rebound it on the next frame, and pulse or flash the affected field so the two things and the page all answer the hit

issues.where: the Enter key, lower right of the keyboard
issues.what: the orange Enter lamp sits identically lit in all 12 frames while action happens around it, so the busiest element on the board never participates in the moment
issues.fix: either dim it during this beat or tie its glow to an actual press so the lit key is part of the story, not static decoration
